confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on thin, crowdsourced Recife and nearby-city data (Expatistan, ZS Associados, Numbeo-derived listings), and the sources conflict. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from the local beer price because no Recife-specific data was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates and were not checked against live listings. The FX observation is the latest official RBA exchange-rates page value I could retrieve (dated 2026-03-20), so it is stale relative to the 2026-10-16 generation date and could not be confirmed as the latest observation. Local-currency prices were converted to USD at an approximate rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No Recife-specific cocktail or wine data was found. Restaurant and coffee levels follow Recife-area crowdsourced figures and comparable Brazilian cities (Salvador, Campinas). Boa Viagem tourist-area prices run above local levels, so the anchors are a blend of local and visitor pricing.
